verdict.rationale: A business-registry and filing service could plausibly offer event-triggered automation, such as automatic alerts or filings on status changes, so this axis applies. The evidence pack documents only manual online and in-person filing, search, and forms, with no user-definable rules or event triggers. missing for 10: any documented rule definition, event triggers, or automated actions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
